creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 11, item 3.

With a `default` command, an arg error on a different, explicitly named command prints the default command's args:

```
$ rad cmd.rad health -z
unknown shorthand flag: 'z' in -z
...
Args for default command 'search':
      --query str

$ rad cmd.rad health -j --raw
Invalid args: 'json' excludes 'raw', but 'raw' was set
...
Args for default command 'search':
```

The user typed `health`, so this reads as if routing went to the wrong command. Once a command is routed, an arg error should print that command's usage, as `health -h` does.

Confirmed on main (3459ddf1).

Where: ra/ra_usage.go:410 (root usage on parse error); likely needs an ra release.
title: An arg error after routing to a command prints the default command's usage
